claims: The Golden State Valkyries are a San Francisco Bay Area-based WNBA expansion team.
The Golden State Valkyries began play in 2025.
The Golden State Valkyries are a Western Conference member.
The Golden State Valkyries are the WNBA's first expansion team since 2008.
The Golden State Valkyries are based at the Chase Center.
The Golden State Valkyries’ official site is valkyries.wnba.com.
The Golden State Valkyries re-signed forward Kayla Thornton to a one-year deal in April 2026.
Kayla Thornton led the Golden State Valkyries in minutes and scoring during their 2025 inaugural season.
The Golden State Valkyries selected Marta Suarez at No. 16 in the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Golden State Valkyries selected Ashlon Jackson at No. 23 in the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Golden State Valkyries selected Kokoro Tanaka at No. 38 in the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Golden State Valkyries traded their initial No. 8 pick, Flau'jae Johnson, to the Seattle Storm for Marta Suarez.
Natalie Nakase serves as the head coach of the Golden State Valkyries.
The Golden State Valkyries' name is derived from Norse mythology.
The Golden State Valkyries' name represents "warrior women".
The Golden State Valkyries' brand features a distinct violet.
The Golden State Valkyries' violet symbolizes "power, speed, and progress".
